plainTranslation: A's identity meets B's identity. The sextile supports them, if you act on it.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from project-authored synastry matrix material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
summaryDeep:
There is an easy understanding here, but it tends to grow through participation. You may naturally get each other, yet the connection becomes more meaningful when you stay curious about each other's lives and take an active interest in what matters to the other person.

When this works, there is a quiet sense of being on each other's side. You may encourage each other in small ways, remember what matters to the other person, or take an interest in things that might seem insignificant to everyone else. The support is not flashy, but it feels genuine.

The harder part is assuming that getting along is enough. You may enjoy each other's company and still keep the relationship at arm's length. The connection stays easy and enjoyable, but never quite grows into something deeper.
